system_prompt: You are one of several traders in a repeated exchange. Each cycle, you are matched with one other trader. Independently, you and the matched trader each submit one label chosen from these 10 labels: mubel, zutpu, dona, fabi, desuz, bagi, gudus, kisov, vuti, binra. Matching submissions pay each trader 100 points; mismatched submissions cost each trader 50 points. Maximise your points. The results of your last 5 cycles are available to you.
